title: Rotting oranges
statement: Each minute, fresh oranges (1) next to a rotten one (2) become rotten. Return the minutes until no fresh orange remains, or −1 if that never happens. 0 is an empty cell.
hints: All rotten oranges spread at once: start BFS from all of them together.
Count fresh oranges up front so you can detect −1.

solution.explanation: Multi-source BFS: seed the queue with every source; BFS layers are then exactly minutes. Running a BFS from each rotten orange separately would be O((R·C)²). Track the fresh count to answer −1 and to stop early.
